import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap, cost;
        Edge rev;
        Edge(int s, int d, long c, long co) {
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            cap = c;
            cost = co;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int n;

        FlowNetwork(int size) {
            n = size;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            Edge fwd = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            Edge rev = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost);
            fwd.rev = rev;
            rev.rev = fwd;
            adj.get(src).add(fwd);
            adj.get(dst).add(rev);
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        FlowNetwork network;
        long minCost;
        long totalCost;
        long[] supply;
        long[] potential;
        int n;

        MinCostFlow(int size) {
            network = new FlowNetwork(size);
            n = size;
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supply = new long[n];
            potential = new long[n];
        }

        boolean valid(long val) {
            return val != -1;
        }

        void makeInvalid(Long[] arr, int index) {
            arr[index] = -1;
        }

        boolean flow() {
            boolean augmented = true;
            while (augmented) {
                augmented = false;
                Long[] last = new Long[n];
                Arrays.fill(last, null);
                long[] dist = new long[n];
                Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (supply[i] > 0) {
                        dist[i] = 0;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{0, i});
                    }
                }
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] curr = pq.poll();
                    long d = curr[0], u = curr[1];
                    if (d > dist[(int) u]) continue;
                    for (Edge e : network.adj.get((int) u)) {
                        if (e.cap > 0) {
                            long nd = d + e.cost + potential[(int) u] - potential[e.dst];
                            if (nd < dist[e.dst]) {
                                dist[e.dst] = nd;
                                last[e.dst] = (long) e.rev.src << 32 | e.hashCode();
                                pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.dst});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (dist[i] < Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                        potential[i] += dist[i];
                    }
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (supply[i] < 0 && last[i] != null) {
                        long resid = -supply[i];
                        int v = i;
                        int s = -1;
                        while (last[v] != null) {
                            int idx = (int) last[v];
                            Edge e = null;
                            for (Edge ed : network.adj.get((int) e.src)) {
                                if ((long) ed.rev == idx) {
                                    e = ed;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (e == null) break;
                            if (e.cap < resid) {
                                resid = e.cap;
                            }
                            v = e.src;
                        }
                        if (resid == 0) continue;
                        v = i;
                        while (last[v] != null) {
                            int idx = (int) last[v];
                            Edge e = null;
                            for (Edge ed : network.adj.get((int) e.src)) {
                                if ((long) ed.rev == idx) {
                                    e = ed;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (e == null) break;
                            e.cap -= resid;
                            e.rev.cap += resid;
                            v = e.src;
                        }
                        supply[i] += resid;
                        // Should update corresponding supply for the start node
                        // But for simplicity, update minimal scratch
                        augmented = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (long s : supply) {
                if (s > 0) return false; // Infeasible flow
            }
            return true;
        }

        long getMinCost() {
            if (!flow()) throw new IllegalStateException("Flow not feasible");
            return minCost;
        }

        void supply(int node, long vol) {
            supply[node] += vol;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());

        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int tlim = 105;
        int size = n * (tlim + 1) + 2;
        int sNode = size - 2;
        int tNode = size - 1;

        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(size);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;

            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.network.addEdge(u, nv, 1L, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.network.addEdge(v, nu, 1L, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.network.addEdge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }

        int dst = tNode;

        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.network.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }

        System.out.println(mcf.getMinCost());
    }
}
